Each year for NYU's CSAW I run a competition called the AI Hardware Attack Challenge, where student teams are challenged to use LLMs to generate and exploit hardware Trojans and vulnerabilities. Your assignment will be to complete this year's qualifying challenge.\
\
You can find details about this year's challenge at this GitHub: [https://github.com/JBlocklove/CSAW-AI-Hardware-Attack-Challenge-2026](https://github.com/JBlocklove/CSAW-AI-Hardware-Attack-Challenge-2026). You will be evaluated on the same rubric as the qualifying challenge.\
